# `/public-machine-identities` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /public-machine-identities/v1

`listPublicMachineIdentitiesV1` — List public machine identities — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Get a list of machine identities with a reduced public payload (`id`, `name`, `description`, and optionally `subtype` and the primary `owner`). Any authenticated user with the default scope can call this endpoint; it does not require the `idn:mis-identity:read` scope.

- Scopes: sp:scopes:default
- User levels: USER
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; name: eq, sw; subtype: eq; owner.id: eq; owner: eq; owner.id: and; owner: is rewritten to — e.g. `name eq "Production API Agent"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: id, name, subtype Sorting on `subtype` is only available when your tenant returns enriched public machine identity data; otherwise the request returns `400 Bad Request`. — e.g. `name`
- Returns 200: array of publicmachineidentity
